review_mode: independent read-only source review with isolated targeted reproductions

findings.title: Completion rejects multiline descriptions emitted by projection
findings.trigger: Use an otherwise eligible implementation milestone whose projected description is Outcome: bounded work. followed by LF and Exit: verified checks.
findings.evidence: validateProjection(..., true) and renderProjection accept/preserve the two-line description; actual forge-close.mjs task CLI --reconcile-only on an isolated real Git root exits 1 with invalid_milestone/preflight and no stderr.
findings.consequence: A legitimate projected implementation milestone blocks both task completion and milestone completion before provider access. The same validator also rejects multiline predecessor descriptions. Rewriting the hosted description to work around this would violate exact identity/content handoff.
findings.bounded_fix: Allow the documented bounded multiline milestone-description text in milestoneInput (for example text(value.description, 16000, true)); keep null, control, reserved-marker and length checks and exact hosted comparison. Decide and document CRLF normalization consistently if added, rather than silently changing exact-content semantics.
findings.objective_recheck: Add a cross-utility case that renders a valid phase request with an LF milestone description and hands that exact description into native completion run(), asserting a completed task and milestone with matching readback. Add a multiline predecessor case and retain invalid controls/marker/oversize negative cases. Run completion plus dependent projection suites and relevant native matrix.

findings.title: Branch validation accepts checkout shorthand while publishing it as literal evidence
findings.trigger: Supply branch @{-1} in an otherwise valid completion handoff for a real repository with a previous checkout.
findings.evidence: Native git check-ref-format --branch @{-1} exits 0 and prints initial; native git check-ref-format refs/heads/@{-1} exits 1. The real public/native run() path with an isolated repository, actual ignored synthetic token and actual lock, injecting only HTTP, returns closed_verified/ok=true, posts Branch: @{-1}, and closes the issue as completed.
findings.consequence: The promised actual valid branch association is replaced with a context-dependent checkout expression in durable evidence. This does not redirect the API repository/issue or establish a forged commit; it weakens evidence accuracy and portability.
findings.bounded_fix: Reject previous-checkout syntax and validate a literal branch identity. For example reject the forbidden @{ sequence in taskInput and/or require the native --branch validation output to equal the supplied branch; preserve the existing leading-dash/invalid-name checks and never evaluate then silently rewrite a caller assertion.
findings.objective_recheck: Use a temporary real Git repository with two checkouts and assert public/native run() rejects @{-1} before token/network/lock writes as appropriate, with zero HTTP calls. Exercise another shorthand such as @{-2}, an invalid literal ref, and ordinary slash/Unicode branch names; rerun completion and relevant native matrix.

limits_and_considered_but_unjudged: No full declared suite was rerun; coordinator owns fresh suite execution and matrix/source-equivalence qualification. Counts and prior results are not independently certified in this report.

No native Windows execution, Windows Job Object/Schannel/process-birth observations, Node 22 execution or Python 3.11 execution was performed by this reviewer. Those branches were source-reviewed. Local probes used Linux, Node 24.22.1, Python 3.12.14 and Git 2.51.1.

Supplied shell run 41781528334 and prior native matrix outcomes are coordinator-provided context, not independently retrieved by this reviewer. This report does not upgrade CI configuration or that context into observed runtime evidence.
No live GitHub/provider mutation, private-provider readback, real credential, fresh consumer, installed-client routing, live Antigravity/Codex activation or live TextStats campaign was exercised.

Public localhost TLS fixtures were structurally parsed and public-key matched; no upstream provenance claim or production trust assessment is made. The fixture is explicitly test-only and bound to local HTTPS.

Trusted local-filesystem limits, adversarial same-user races and privileged broker/process escape remain the documented boundary. Arbitrary OS denial, procfs/PID namespace facilities, exotic filesystem aliases, CPU stalls and external service lifetimes were not independently stress-tested.

Shell source tests cover the two documented launcher/escaping forms under controlled CMD defaults; arbitrary wrappers, delayed-expansion host configuration, percent-literal edge cases and actual agent adherence were not established. These are evidence limits, not confirmed failures of the selected contract.

The canonical Markdown reader is deliberately not a general Markdown parser or semantic acceptance/dependency engine. Alternate HTML/block layouts and caller truth/ownership across other lists remain backend/caller obligations; no expanded parser requirement is inferred.

Case-variant completion milestone titles, external concurrency and provider eventual consistency were considered. Completion ownership uses the documented exact generated identity; cross-machine exclusivity remains caller-owned and exact-readback unknown/conflict results prevent unproved success. No independent defect is asserted without a contrary contract or reproduction.

U-003 publisher/schema/dependencies/package/release composition, closed campaigns through 145, historical release/manual transcripts and real credentials were excluded. Additional code/contract reads were limited to consequential U-002 interfaces.
readiness: Source coverage complete for this subarea; not ready for unconditional acceptance until the two confirmed bounded validation defects are resolved or explicitly dispositioned. No critical/high finding. Coordinator-owned full suites, native CI and release acceptance remain separate.
